questions.question: A trader buys 250 articles, each at the same price. He sells 60% of them at a profit of 40%; one-fifth of them at a loss of 25% and the remaining articles at a loss equal to the cost price of 5 articles. His gain/loss percentage in the entire transaction is:
questions.questionHtml: A trader buys 250 articles, each at the same price. He sells 60% of them at a profit of 40%; one-fifth of them at a loss of 25% and the remaining articles at a loss equal to the cost price of 5 articles. His gain/loss percentage in the entire transaction is:
questions.solution:
Let cost per article = ₹1 ⇒ total cost = ₹250.
60% (150) sold at 40% profit ⇒ SP = 150 × 1.4 = 210.


One-fifth (50) sold at 25% loss ⇒ SP = 50 × 0.75 = 37.5.
Remaining 50 sold at loss equal to cost of 5 ⇒ total loss = 5 ⇒ SP = 50 − 5 = 45.


Total SP = 210 + 37.5 + 45 = 292.5 ⇒ Profit = 292.5 − 250 = 42.5.
%Gain = (42.5 ÷ 250) × 100 = 17% .

questions.question: During a sale, 30% of the goods are sold at a 40% profit, 20% of the remaining goods are sold at a 37% profit, and the still remaining goods are sold at a loss of 48%. If there is an overall loss of x%, then what is the value of x?
questions.questionHtml: During a sale, 30% of the goods are sold at a 40% profit, 20% of the remaining goods are sold at a 37% profit, and the still remaining goods are sold at a loss of 48%. If there is an overall loss of x%, then what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
Assume total cost = 100 (units at ₹1).
30 units at 40% profit ⇒ SP = 30×1.4 = 42; remaining 70.
20% of 70 i.e., 14 at 37% profit ⇒ SP = 14×1.37 = 19.18; remaining 56 at 48% loss ⇒ SP = 56×0.52 = 29.12.


Total SP = 42 + 19.18 + 29.12 = 90.30 ⇒ loss = 100 − 90.30 = 9.70 ⇒ x = 9.7% .

questions.question: A skill development institute offers three courses: Alpha, Beta and Gamma. In the previous month, the number of enrollments were as follows:Alpha: 9,000 studentsBeta: 11,000 studentsGamma: 7,000 studentsIn the current month, the enrollments in Alpha increased by 25%, enrollments in Beta decreased by 10% and enrollments in Gamma increased by 30%. The institute earns ₹50 per Alpha enrollment, ₹65 per Beta enrollment and ₹80 per Gamma enrollment. However, the institute introduced a 7% promotional discount on Gamma course fee in the current month. By what percentage has the company's total earnings increased compared to the previous month? (Round off the answer to two decimal places.)
questions.questionHtml: A skill development institute offers three courses: Alpha, Beta and Gamma. In the previous month, the number of enrollments were as follows:Alpha: 9,000 studentsBeta: 11,000 studentsGamma: 7,000 studentsIn the current month, the enrollments in Alpha increased by 25%, enrollments in Beta decreased by 10% and enrollments in Gamma increased by 30%. The institute earns ₹50 per Alpha enrollment, ₹65 per Beta enrollment and ₹80 per Gamma enrollment. However, the institute introduced a 7% promotional discount on Gamma course fee in the current month. By what percentage has the company's total earnings increased compared to the previous month? (Round off the answer to two decimal places.)
questions.solution:
Previous month enrollments :

Alpha: 9,000

Beta: 11,000

Gamma: 7,000

Current month enrollments :

Alpha: 9,000 × 1.25 = 11,250

Beta: 11,000 × 0.90 = 9,900

Gamma: 7,000 × 1.30 = 9,100

Earnings per enrollment :

Alpha: ₹50

Beta: ₹65

Gamma: ₹80 (previous month), ₹80 × 0.93 = ₹74.40 (current month, after 7% discount)

Previous month total earnings:
= (9,000 × 50) + (11,000 × 65) + (7,000 × 80)
= ₹450,000 + ₹715,000 + ₹560,000 = ₹1,725,000

Current month total earnings:
= (11,250 × 50) + (9,900 × 65) + (9,100 × 74.40)
= ₹562,500 + ₹643,500 + ₹677,040 = ₹1,883,040

Percentage increase in total earnings:
= [(1,883,040 - 1,725,000) / 1,725,000] × 100 ≈ 9.16%

questions.question: Three runners, X, Y and Z, run on a circular track of circumference 500 m. They all start from the same point at the same time. X runs at 4 m/s, Y at 5 m/s and Z at 10 m/s, all in the same direction. After how much time will all three runners be at the same point for the second time?
questions.questionHtml: Three runners, X, Y and Z, run on a circular track of circumference 500 m. They all start from the same point at the same time. X runs at 4 m/s, Y at 5 m/s and Z at 10 m/s, all in the same direction. After how much time will all three runners be at the same point for the second time?
questions.solution:
Circumference of track = 500 m
Speeds of X, Y, and Z = 4 m/s, 5 m/s, and 10 m/s respectively.
Since they start together and run in the same direction, they will meet again when the differences in distances covered by each pair are multiples of 500 m.

We find the LCM of their time periods to complete one round:
Time taken by X for one round = 500 / 4 = 125 s
Time taken by Y for one round = 500 / 5 = 100 s
Time taken by Z for one round = 500 / 10 = 50 s

Now, LCM(125, 100, 50) = 500 seconds

Thus, all three runners will meet at the same point after every 500 seconds .
T ime to meet second time from start = 500*2 = 1000s = 16 minutes and 40 seconds

questions.question: A watercraft takes 6 hours 15 minutes to travel 48 km upstream and 3 hours 45 minutes to travel 81 km downstream in a river. If the watercraft travels 216 km upstream and then 216 km downstream, how much total time will it take and what is the watercraft’s speed (in km/hr) in the still water?
questions.questionHtml: A watercraft takes 6 hours 15 minutes to travel 48 km upstream and 3 hours 45 minutes to travel 81 km downstream in a river. If the watercraft travels 216 km upstream and then 216 km downstream, how much total time will it take and what is the watercraft’s speed (in km/hr) in the still water?
questions.solution:
Upstream: 48 km in 6 h 15 min = 6.25 h → speed = 48 / 6.25 = 7.68 km/h
Downstream: 81 km in 3 h 45 min = 3.75 h → speed = 81 / 3.75 = 21.6 km/h

Let boat speed = b, stream speed = s
Then,
b − s = 7.68
b + s = 21.6
⇒ 2b = 29.28 ⇒ b = 14.64 km/h , s = 6.96 km/h

For 216 km upstream: time = 216 / 7.68 = 28.125 h
For 216 km downstream: time = 216 / 21.6 = 10 h
Total time = 38.125 h = 38 hours 7 minutes 30 seconds

questions.question: Two positive numbers differ by 2364. When the greater number is divided by the smaller number, the quotient is 3 and the remainder is 192. What is the HCF of the greater of the two given numbers and 3996?
questions.questionHtml: Two positive numbers differ by 2364. When the greater number is divided by the smaller number, the quotient is 3 and the remainder is 192. What is the HCF of the greater of the two given numbers and 3996?
questions.solution:
Let the greater number be x and the smaller number be y .
Given:
x − y = 2364 …(1)
Also, when x is divided by y , quotient = 3 and remainder = 192.
Hence, x = 3y + 192 …(2)

Substitute (2) in (1):
(3y + 192) − y = 2364
⇒ 2y = 2172
⇒ y = 1086

Now,
x = 3y + 192 = 3(1086) + 192 = 3258 + 192 = 3450

We need HCF of 3450 and 3996 .

Prime factorisation:
3450 = 2 × 3 × 5² × 23
3996 = 2² × 3 × 7 × 19

Common factors = 2 × 3 = 6
